task_description: Summarize each dataset row into one sentence in the same language as the input. Platform feeds each CSV/JSONL row as outer_context (fields input and task; score against expected).

steps.title: Extract key facts
steps.aim: List the essential facts from the source text without interpretation
steps.stage_action: Read the source text from the Data section (fields input or task). Output 2–4 short bullet lines, each one fact. Same language as the input. No full sentences yet.
steps.reasoning_questions: Which facts are necessary for the gist? Which details can be omitted?

steps.title: Draft one sentence
steps.aim: Compress the key facts into one rough summary sentence
steps.stage_action: Using the bullet facts from the previous step, write one sentence that captures the main idea. Same language as the source. Plain text only.
steps.reasoning_questions: How to merge the facts into one coherent line? What is the core claim?

steps.title: Polish final sentence
steps.aim: Produce the final one-sentence summary ready for scoring
steps.stage_action: Polish the draft into exactly one grammatically correct sentence. Preserve meaning; remove redundancy. Same language as the input. No markdown, no quotes, no preamble.
steps.reasoning_questions: Is grammar natural? Is the sentence as short as possible while staying accurate?
